title: Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism at Ammapattinam Lighthouse.
summary: E-tender for civil and electrical improvement works to promote tourism at Ammapattinam Lighthouse, Pudukkottai District, Tamil Nadu, issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai

sites.name: Ammapattinam Lighthouse, Pudukkottai District, Tamilnadu
sites.work: Civil and electrical improvement works for tourism promotion

scope.item: Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism - civil portion
Improvement of works in connection with promotion of tourism - electrical portion

money.notes: Estimated cost Rs 11,95,878 including 18% GST: civil Rs 8,93,497, electrical Rs 3,02,381. EMD by DD/FDR of any scheduled bank in favour of Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Chennai, valid three months from technical bid opening. Tender fee 'as per NIT' by DD but amount not printed.

period.bid_validity: 90 days from date of opening of technical bid

eligibility: Valid registration in appropriate category and class with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other State/Central Govt/PSU/autonomous body

Similar works completed in last seven years: three works each >= 40%, or two each >= 50%, or one >= 80% of estimated cost; only fully completed works with completion certificate; value enhanced at 7% simple per annum; certificates below Executive Engineer rank not considered
Similar works: repairs and civil maintenance of building or construction of any type of building/compound wall/retaining wall/RCC work
Key technical personnel for supervision and execution with qualifications and experience

Unconditional tender undertaking (Annexure III), tender acceptance letter (Annexure II), affidavit of not being blacklisted, list of relatives serving in MoPSW/DGLL, Make in India self-certification (Annexure VI)
notes: Scanned Section I NIT only; no BOQ or description of the individual tourism improvement items. Download and bid submission 10.10.2025 10:00 to 24.10.2025 15:00; EMD and tender fee originals up to 24.10.2025 15:00; opening 27.10.2025 15:00. Eligibility table row is numbered 3, duplicating the estimated cost row number.
